name: Teen and Adult Volunteer Program, Jefferson Abington Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer at a hospital outside Philadelphia. You might help staff on patient floors, guide visitors, or visit patients to keep them company. No medical training needed.
who_can_apply: Anyone at least 16 years old who meets Jefferson's vaccination and medical rules.
duration: Most assignments need at least 2 to 4 hours a week. Some late afternoon, evening or weekend shifts.
how_to_apply: Submit the volunteer application from the hospital's volunteer page. If accepted, you complete a Pennsylvania background check (the hospital runs it), orientation paperwork, and proof of vaccines (chicken pox, MMR, Tdap, a recent TB blood test, and a flu shot in flu season).
notes: Volunteering here does not lead to a job, but it is health care experience for your resume. Shadowing is possible only if you find a staff member to supervise you yourself. Jefferson's Center City hospitals (TJUH and Methodist) take volunteers 18 and up only. Questions: 215-481-2492.
